ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a map near southern Africa, with “Atlantic Ocean” marked on the left and “Indian Ocean” marked on the right; the outline of the southern end of Africa and latitude and longitude lines can be seen, and shaded diagonal lines cover a relatively large area of southern Africa. Then reason: the question stem asks to judge the agricultural regional type represented by this shaded distribution. Combining the sea-land position and latitude and longitude shown in the figure, it can be confirmed that the shaded area is located in southern Africa; in the distribution of world agricultural regional types, southern Africa is an important distribution area of large-scale ranching. Therefore, the agricultural regional type represented by the shaded part in the figure is large-scale ranching.
